title: If Droids Can Frolic
description: IF DROIDS CAN FROLIC, that's what R2-D2 is doing in this painting (front) by Bunny Carter, used for a Drawing Board greeting card that wishes: Hope this  special day is fill of wonder for you. The little rabbit-like creatures resemble the telepathic Hoojibs from the STAR WARS comic book series. One of George Lucas' favonte pieces of merchandise from the trilogy is this early Artoo ceramic cookie jar (back) produced by Roman Ceramics.
